changeSet.sql: UPDATE generator g SET reactivelimitskind = CASE WHEN curvereactivelimitsproperties IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reactivecapabilitycurvepoint p WHERE p.networkuuid = g.networkuuid AND p.variantnum = g.variantnum AND p.equipmentid = g.id AND p.equipmenttype = 'GENERATOR' ) THEN 'CURVE' ELSE 'MIN_MAX' END WHERE reactivelimitskind IS NULL;

UPDATE battery b SET reactivelimitskind = CASE WHEN curvereactivelimitsproperties IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reactivecapabilitycurvepoint p WHERE p.networkuuid = b.networkuuid AND p.variantnum = b.variantnum AND p.equipmentid = b.id AND p.equipmenttype = 'BATTERY' ) THEN 'CURVE' ELSE 'MIN_MAX' END WHERE reactivelimitskind IS NULL;

UPDATE vscconverterstation v SET reactivelimitskind = CASE WHEN curvereactivelimitsproperties IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reactivecapabilitycurvepoint p WHERE p.networkuuid = v.networkuuid AND p.variantnum = v.variantnum AND p.equipmentid = v.id AND p.equipmenttype = 'VSC_CONVERTER_STATION' ) THEN 'CURVE' ELSE 'MIN_MAX' END WHERE reactivelimitskind IS NULL;
